note_ne: DHM मौसम पूर्वानुमान महाशाखाको साइट dhm.gov.np/mfd खुल्यो; मंसिर १२ बिहान ८ बजे जारी ५ दिने मौसम चेतावनी (१२४५९) सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो हो। नक्साका रङ १२४५६ बाट बदलिएका छैनन्। नक्सा पढियो: मंसिर १२ देखि मंसिर १६ सम्म पाँचै दिन देशभर हरियो; रातो, सुन्तला वा पहेँलो चेतावनी छैन। नदीको तह यस पटक पुनः जाँचिएको छैन; पछिल्लो अवस्था नदी पृष्ठमा हेर्नुहोस्।
note_en: DHM's forecasting site dhm.gov.np/mfd loaded; the 5-day weather warning issued at 8 AM Mangsir 12 (12459) is the latest. Map colours are unchanged from 12456. Maps read: green across the country on all five days, Mangsir 12 to Mangsir 16 (28 Nov to 2 Dec); no red, orange or yellow. River levels were not re-checked in this pass; see the Rivers page for the latest.

bulletin5.advisory_ne: मंसिर १२ देखि मंसिर १६ सम्म पाँचै दिन देशभर कुनै मौसम चेतावनी छैन; सबै हरियो।
bulletin5.advisory_en: No weather warning anywhere for all five days, Mangsir 12 to Mangsir 16 (28 Nov to 2 Dec); all green.

bulletin5.map_note_en: DHM's 5-day warning maps are green (no warning) across the country on all five days, Mangsir 11 to Mangsir 15.

country.analysis_ne: हाल नेपालमा कुनै पनि मौसमी प्रणालीको उल्लेखनीय प्रभाव रहेको छैन ।
country.analysis_en: Currently, no significant weather system is affecting Nepal.
country.day_ne: देशको हिमाली क्षेत्रमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ, बाँकी क्षेत्रमा मौसम मूख्यतया सफा रहनेछ। कोशी, बागमती र गण्डकी प्रदेशको हिमाली भू-भागका एक-दुई स्थानमा हल्का वर्षा/हिमपातको सम्भावना छ ।
country.day_en: Partly cloudy conditions will prevail in the Himalayan regions of the country, while the weather will remain mainly fair in the remaining areas. Light rain/snowfall is likely at one or two places in the Himalayan regions of Koshi, Bagmati and Gandaki Provinces.
country.night_ne: कोशी, मधेश, बागमती, लुम्बिनी र कर्णाली प्रदेशमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ, बाँकी क्षेत्रमा मौसम मूख्यतया सफा रहनेछ। बिहानपख उपत्यका र खोँचहरूका साथै तराई भू-भागका थोरै स्थानमा हुस्सु/कुहिरो लाग्नेछ ।
country.night_en: Partly cloudy conditions will prevail in Koshi, Madhesh, Bagmati, Lumbini and Karnali Provinces, while the weather will remain mainly fair in the remaining areas. Mist/fog is likely at a few places in valleys and gorges, as well as in the Terai regions, during the early morning.
